from datetime import datetime

import pytest
from isoduration import add_duration


# ============================================================================
# SYNTAX VALIDATION TESTS
# ============================================================================


class TestSyntaxValidation:
    """Test parsing and syntax validation of ISO 8601 durations."""

    def test_basic_days(self):
        """Single day component."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1D") == datetime(2025, 3, 11)

    def test_basic_weeks(self):
        """Single week component."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1W") == datetime(2025, 3, 17)

    def test_basic_months(self):
        """Single month component."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15), "P1M") == datetime(2025, 2, 15)

    def test_basic_years(self):
        """Single year component."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15), "P1Y") == datetime(2026, 1, 15)

    def test_basic_time_hours(self):
        """Single hour component."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5), "PT1H") == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 6)

    def test_basic_time_minutes(self):
        """Single minute component."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5, 30), "PT30M") == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 6)

    def test_basic_time_seconds(self):
        """Single second component."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5, 0, 30), "PT30S") == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5, 1)

    def test_plus_sign(self):
        """Plus sign is allowed and means positive."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "+P1D") == datetime(2025, 3, 11)

    def test_minus_sign(self):
        """Minus sign negates the duration."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "-P1D") == datetime(2025, 3, 9)

    def test_no_sign(self):
        """No sign is valid and means positive."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1D") == datetime(2025, 3, 11)

    def test_leading_zeros_in_components(self):
        """Leading zeros are allowed in numeric components."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P01D") == datetime(2025, 3, 11)
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P001D") == datetime(2025, 3, 11)

    def test_decimal_separator_dot(self):
        """Dot is valid decimal separator for the last component."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "PT1.5H") == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 1, 30)

    def test_decimal_separator_comma(self):
        """Comma is valid decimal separator for the last component."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "PT1,5H") == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 1, 30)

    def test_multiple_components_ordered(self):
        """Multiple components in order are valid."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15, 8, 30), "P1Y2M3DT4H5M6S") == datetime(2026, 3, 18, 12, 35, 6)

    # ========== Invalid syntax tests ==========

    def test_missing_p_designator(self):
        """P is required."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "1D")

    def test_p_designator_only(self):
        """P alone is invalid; at least one component required."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P")

    def test_pt_designator_only(self):
        """PT without time components is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "PT")

    def test_p_with_no_components(self):
        """P must be followed by at least one component."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P")

    def test_p_with_t_but_no_time_component(self):
        """T must be followed by at least one time component."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1DT")

    def test_whitespace_in_duration(self):
        """Whitespace is not allowed."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P 1D")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1 D")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1D T1H")

    def test_sign_on_component_not_duration(self):
        """Sign must be on the duration, not on individual components."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P-1D")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1D-T1H")

    def test_lowercase_designators(self):
        """Designators must be uppercase."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "p1d")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1d")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "pt1h")

    def test_components_out_of_order(self):
        """Components must be in order: Y, M, W, D, T, H, M, S."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1D1M")  # day before month
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1DT1H1M2M")  # T before D is wrong
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "PT1H1D")  # day after time

    def test_component_appears_multiple_times(self):
        """Each component appears at most once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1D2D")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1Y2Y")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "PT1H2H")

    def test_weeks_cannot_combine_with_days(self):
        """W cannot be combined with D (or Y, M)."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P2W3D")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1Y2W")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1M2W")

    def test_weeks_alone_is_valid(self):
        """W alone is valid."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P2W") == datetime(2025, 3, 24)

    def test_weeks_cannot_combine_with_time(self):
        """W cannot be combined with time components."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1WT1H")

    def test_missing_number_before_designator(self):
        """A designator must have a number before it."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "PD")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "PT H")

    def test_no_designator_between_components(self):
        """Components need explicit designators."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1 2D")

    def test_decimal_on_non_last_component_date(self):
        """Fractions only allowed on the last component (date side)."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1.5Y2M")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1Y2.5M")

    def test_decimal_on_non_last_component_time(self):
        """Fractions only allowed on the last component (time side)."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "PT1.5H2M")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "PT1H2.5M")

    def test_decimal_on_years(self):
        """Fractions are not allowed on years."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1.5Y")

    def test_decimal_on_months(self):
        """Fractions are not allowed on months."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 1), "P1M2.5M")  # Actually this is duplicate M anyway

    def test_m_before_t_is_months(self):
        """M before T is months, not minutes."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15), "P2M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 15)

    def test_m_after_t_is_minutes(self):
        """M after T is minutes."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 12, 0), "PT30M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 12, 30)

    def test_decimal_needs_digits_on_both_sides(self):
        """Decimal separator requires at least one digit on each side."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "PT.5H")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "PT1.H")

    def test_empty_string(self):
        """Empty string is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "")

    def test_multiple_decimal_separators(self):
        """Only one decimal point allowed."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "PT1.5.5S")


# ============================================================================
# YEAR AND MONTH TESTS
# ============================================================================


class TestYearsAndMonths:
    """Test year and month components following ISO 8601 rules."""

    def test_add_single_year(self):
        """Add exactly one year."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 15), "P1Y") == datetime(2026, 3, 15)

    def test_add_multiple_years(self):
        """Add multiple years at once."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 15), "P5Y") == datetime(2030, 3, 15)

    def test_add_single_month(self):
        """Add exactly one month."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15), "P1M") == datetime(2025, 2, 15)

    def test_add_multiple_months(self):
        """Add multiple months at once."""
        assert add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15), "P6M") == datetime(2025, 7, 15)

    def test_add_year_and_month_together(self):
        """Year and month are combined into total months before applying."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P1Y1M")
        # 1Y + 1M = 13 months total, applied in one step
        # Jan 31 + 13 months (to Feb of 2025, day 31 doesn't exist, so use last day)
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_month_overflow_leap_year(self):
        """When day doesn't exist in target month, use last day (leap year)."""
        # 2024 is a leap year, Feb has 29 days
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 29)

    def test_month_overflow_non_leap_year(self):
        """When day doesn't exist in target month, use last day (non-leap year)."""
        # 2025 is not a leap year, Feb has 28 days
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 31), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_multiple_months_overflow(self):
        """Adding multiple months may hit an overflow."""
        # March 31 + 11 months = Feb (non-leap), use Feb 28
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 31), "P11M")
        assert result == datetime(2026, 2, 28)

    def test_leap_year_february_29_add_year(self):
        """Feb 29 + 1 year in a leap year."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 2, 29), "P1Y")
        # 2025 is not a leap year, so Feb has 28 days
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_leap_year_february_29_add_four_years(self):
        """Feb 29 + 4 years lands on another leap year."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 2, 29), "P4Y")
        assert result == datetime(2028, 2, 29)

    def test_subtract_single_month(self):
        """Subtract exactly one month."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 15), "-P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 15)

    def test_subtract_month_overflow(self):
        """When subtracting months, day overflow applies (backward)."""
        # Mar 31 - 1 month = Feb 29 (leap year)
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 3, 31), "-P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 29)

    def test_subtract_multiple_months(self):
        """Subtract multiple months."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 12, 15), "-P6M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 6, 15)

    def test_negative_year_and_month_separate_steps(self):
        """Negative duration with year and month applied together."""
        # 2024-03-31 minus P1M1D: first back 1 month to 2024-02-01, then back 1 day
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 3, 1), "-P1M1D")
        # 2024-03-01 - 1 month = 2024-02-01, then - 1 day = 2024-01-31
        assert result == datetime(2024, 1, 31)

    def test_year_month_preserves_time(self):
        """Hours, minutes, seconds are preserved when adding years/months."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15, 14, 30, 45), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 15, 14, 30, 45)

    def test_add_year_to_leap_day(self):
        """Adding a year to Feb 29."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 2, 29), "P1Y")
        # 2021 is not a leap year
        assert result == datetime(2021, 2, 28)

    def test_december_plus_one_month(self):
        """Adding one month to December goes to next year."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 12, 15), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2026, 1, 15)

    def test_january_minus_one_month(self):
        """Subtracting one month from January goes to previous year."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15), "-P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 12, 15)

    def test_month_overflow_with_thirty_day_month(self):
        """Adding one month from a 31-day month to a 30-day month."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 31), "P1M")
        # February has 28 days in 2025 (non-leap)
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_zero_years(self):
        """Zero years are allowed (no-op)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 15), "P0Y")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 15)

    def test_zero_months(self):
        """Zero months are allowed (no-op)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 15), "P0M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 15)

    def test_very_large_month_addition(self):
        """Add a very large number of months."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15), "P100M")
        # 100 months = 8 years and 4 months
        assert result == datetime(2033, 5, 15)


# ============================================================================
# WEEK AND DAY TESTS
# ============================================================================


class TestWeeksAndDays:
    """Test week and day components."""

    def test_add_single_day(self):
        """Add exactly one day."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 11)

    def test_add_multiple_days(self):
        """Add multiple days."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P5D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 15)

    def test_add_single_week(self):
        """Add exactly one week (7 days)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1W")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 17)

    def test_add_multiple_weeks(self):
        """Add multiple weeks."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P3W")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 31)

    def test_weeks_overflow_to_next_month(self):
        """Adding weeks may cross month boundary."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 2, 28), "P1W")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 7)

    def test_weeks_overflow_to_next_year(self):
        """Adding weeks may cross year boundary."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 12, 28), "P1W")
        assert result == datetime(2026, 1, 4)

    def test_subtract_days(self):
        """Subtract days."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 15), "-P5D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10)

    def test_subtract_weeks(self):
        """Subtract weeks."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 20), "-P2W")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 6)

    def test_subtract_days_overflow_to_previous_month(self):
        """Subtracting days crosses month boundary."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 5), "-P5D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_subtract_days_overflow_to_previous_year(self):
        """Subtracting days crosses year boundary."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 5), "-P5D")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 12, 31)

    def test_fractional_weeks(self):
        """Fractional weeks are allowed (last component rule)."""
        # 0.5 weeks = 3.5 days
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P0.5W")
        # 3.5 days = 3 days + 12 hours
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 13, 12, 0, 0)

    def test_fractional_days(self):
        """Fractional days are allowed (last component rule)."""
        # 0.5 days = 12 hours
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P0.5D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 12, 0, 0)

    def test_fractional_days_with_time(self):
        """Fractional days work with existing time."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 6, 0), "P0.5D")
        # 0.5 days = 12 hours
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 18, 0, 0)

    def test_negative_fractional_days(self):
        """Negative fractional days."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 12, 0), "-P0.5D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 0, 0, 0)

    def test_zero_days(self):
        """Zero days are allowed (no-op)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P0D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10)

    def test_zero_weeks(self):
        """Zero weeks are allowed (no-op)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P0W")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10)

    def test_days_overflow_across_leap_year(self):
        """Adding days across a leap year."""
        # 2024-02-28 + 1 day = 2024-02-29 (leap year)
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 2, 28), "P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 29)

    def test_days_across_leap_year_boundary(self):
        """Adding days that cross leap year boundary."""
        # 2024-02-29 + 1 day = 2024-03-01
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 2, 29), "P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 3, 1)

    def test_large_fractional_day(self):
        """Large fractional day value."""
        # 2.5 days = 2 days + 12 hours
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P2.5D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 12, 12, 0, 0)

# ============================================================================


class TestTimeComponents:
    """Test hours, minutes, and seconds."""

    def test_add_hours(self):
        """Add hours."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5), "PT1H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 6)

    def test_add_multiple_hours(self):
        """Add multiple hours."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5), "PT3H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 8)

    def test_add_minutes(self):
        """Add minutes."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5, 30), "PT15M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5, 45)

    def test_add_seconds(self):
        """Add seconds."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5, 0, 30), "PT30S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5, 1, 0)

    def test_add_all_time_components(self):
        """Add hours, minutes, and seconds together."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 1, 1, 1), "PT1H2M3S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 2, 3, 4)

    def test_hours_overflow_to_next_day(self):
        """Adding hours overflows to the next day."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 22), "PT3H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 11, 1)

    def test_hours_overflow_to_next_month(self):
        """Adding hours overflows across month boundary."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 31, 23), "PT2H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 4, 1, 1)

    def test_hours_overflow_to_next_year(self):
        """Adding hours overflows across year boundary."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 12, 31, 23), "PT2H")
        assert result == datetime(2026, 1, 1, 1)

    def test_subtract_hours(self):
        """Subtract hours."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5), "-PT2H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 3)

    def test_subtract_hours_overflow_to_previous_day(self):
        """Subtracting hours underflows to previous day."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 2), "-PT3H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 9, 23)

    def test_fractional_hours(self):
        """Fractional hours are allowed."""
        # 1.5 hours = 1 hour + 30 minutes
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5), "PT1.5H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 6, 30, 0)

    def test_fractional_minutes(self):
        """Fractional minutes are allowed."""
        # 30.5 minutes = 30 minutes + 30 seconds
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5), "PT30.5M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5, 30, 30)

    def test_fractional_seconds(self):
        """Fractional seconds are allowed."""
        # 45.5 seconds = 45 seconds + 500 milliseconds
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5, 0, 0), "PT45.5S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5, 0, 45, 500000)

    def test_fractional_seconds_microsecond_precision(self):
        """Fractional seconds respect microsecond precision."""
        # 1.123456 seconds
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5, 0, 0), "PT1.123456S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5, 0, 1, 123456)

    def test_fractional_seconds_rounding(self):
        """Very small fractions round to nearest microsecond."""
        # 0.0000005 seconds (0.5 microseconds, should round to 1 microsecond)
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5, 0, 0), "PT0.0000005S")
        # May round up or down depending on implementation, but should be valid
        assert result.microsecond in [0, 1]

    def test_large_seconds(self):
        """Large second values overflow to minutes."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5, 0, 0), "PT90S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5, 1, 30)

    def test_large_minutes(self):
        """Large minute values overflow to hours."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5, 0), "PT90M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 6, 30)

    def test_large_hours(self):
        """Large hour values overflow to days."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5), "PT25H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 11, 6)

    def test_subtract_minutes(self):
        """Subtract minutes."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5, 30), "-PT15M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5, 15)

    def test_subtract_seconds(self):
        """Subtract seconds."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5, 0, 30), "-PT30S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5, 0, 0)

    def test_zero_hours(self):
        """Zero hours are allowed (no-op)."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5), "PT0H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5)

    def test_zero_time(self):
        """PT0S is the smallest non-empty time duration."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5), "PT0S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 5)

    def test_midnight(self):
        """Adding time starting from midnight."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 0, 0, 0), "PT1S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 0, 0, 1)


# ============================================================================
# COMBINED AND COMPLEX TESTS
# ============================================================================


class TestCombinedDurations:
    """Test durations with multiple component types."""

    def test_full_duration_all_components(self):
        """P1Y2M10DT2H30M with all components."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15, 10, 15), "P1Y2M10DT2H30M")
        # 2025-01-15 + 1Y2M = 2026-03-15
        # 2026-03-15 + 10D = 2026-03-25
        # 2026-03-25 10:15 + 2H30M = 2026-03-25 12:45
        assert result == datetime(2026, 3, 25, 12, 45)

    def test_months_and_days(self):
        """P2M5D combines month and day components."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15), "P2M5D")
        # 2025-01-15 + 2M = 2025-03-15
        # 2025-03-15 + 5D = 2025-03-20
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 20)

    def test_days_and_time(self):
        """P2DT3H combines days and time."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 10), "P2DT3H")
        # 2025-03-10 10:00 + 2D = 2025-03-12 10:00
        # 2025-03-12 10:00 + 3H = 2025-03-12 13:00
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 12, 13, 0)

    def test_months_and_time(self):
        """P1MT2H combines months and time."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15, 10), "P1MT2H")
        # 2025-01-15 10:00 + 1M = 2025-02-15 10:00
        # 2025-02-15 10:00 + 2H = 2025-02-15 12:00
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 15, 12, 0)

    def test_negative_full_duration(self):
        """Full negative duration."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 15, 15, 30), "-P1Y2M10DT2H30M")
        # This applies each part negatively in order
        # Start: 2025-03-15 15:30
        # - 1Y2M (13 months): 2024-02-15 15:30
        # - 10D: 2024-02-05 15:30
        # - 2H30M: 2024-02-05 13:00
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 5, 13, 0)

    def test_negative_with_month_overflow(self):
        """Negative duration with month overflow."""
        # 2024-03-01 minus P1M1D
        # - 1M: 2024-02-01
        # - 1D: 2024-01-31
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 3, 1), "-P1M1D")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 1, 31)

    def test_month_overflow_with_time(self):
        """Month overflow combined with time components."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31, 10, 30), "P1MT5H")
        # 2024-01-31 + 1M = 2024-02-29 (overflow to last day)
        # 2024-02-29 10:30 + 5H = 2024-02-29 15:30
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 29, 15, 30)

    def test_fractional_day_with_time_component(self):
        """P0.5DT1H combines fractional day with time."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 0), "P0.5DT1H")
        # 0.5D = 12 hours
        # Total: 12H + 1H = 13H = 13:00 on the same day
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 13, 0)

    def test_negative_fractional_duration(self):
        """Negative fractional duration."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 12, 0), "-P0.5D")
        # - 0.5D = - 12H
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 0, 0)

    def test_very_large_combined_duration(self):
        """Large duration combining all types."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2020, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0), "P10Y5M20DT100H")
        # 2020-01-01 + 10Y5M = 2030-06-01
        # 2030-06-01 + 20D = 2030-06-21
        # 2030-06-21 + 100H = 2030-06-25 04:00
        assert result == datetime(2030, 6, 25, 4, 0, 0)

    def test_leap_day_with_months_and_time(self):
        """Leap day with complex duration."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 2, 29, 10, 0), "P1YT5H")
        # 2024-02-29 + 1Y = 2025-02-28 (non-leap year)
        # 2025-02-28 10:00 + 5H = 2025-02-28 15:00
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28, 15, 0)


# ============================================================================
# EDGE CASES AND BOUNDARY TESTS
# ============================================================================


class TestEdgeCases:
    """Test edge cases and boundary conditions."""

    def test_minimum_datetime(self):
        """Adding duration to minimum datetime works within bounds."""
        min_dt = datetime.min
        # Try to add a small duration that stays in bounds
        result = add_duration(min_dt, "P0D")
        assert result == min_dt

    def test_maximum_datetime(self):
        """Adding zero duration to maximum datetime."""
        max_dt = datetime.max
        result = add_duration(max_dt, "P0D")
        assert result == max_dt

    def test_adding_causing_overflow_raises_error(self):
        """Adding a duration that would exceed max datetime raises ValueError."""
        max_dt = datetime.max
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(max_dt, "P1D")

    def test_subtracting_causing_underflow_raises_error(self):
        """Subtracting a duration that would go below min datetime raises ValueError."""
        min_dt = datetime.min
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(min_dt, "-P1D")

    def test_multiple_month_boundaries_in_calculation(self):
        """Complex case crossing multiple month boundaries."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 31), "P2M")
        # Jan 31 + 2 months = Mar, day 31 exists
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 31)

    def test_year_boundary(self):
        """Duration crossing year boundary."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 12, 1), "P2M")
        # Dec 1 + 2 months = Feb (next year)
        assert result == datetime(2026, 2, 1)

    def test_time_exactly_midnight(self):
        """Time component resulting in exact midnight."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 12, 0), "PT12H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 11, 0, 0, 0)

    def test_very_small_fractional_second(self):
        """Very small fractional second values."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "PT0.000001S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 0, 0, 0, 1)

    def test_nanosecond_precision_lost(self):
        """Precision below microsecond is lost/rounded."""
        # This should round to microsecond precision
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "PT0.0000001S")
        # Should be 0 or 1 microsecond depending on rounding
        assert result.microsecond in [0, 1]

    def test_comma_decimal_with_many_digits(self):
        """Comma decimal separator with many digits."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "PT1,5H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 1, 30, 0)

    def test_dot_decimal_with_many_digits(self):
        """Dot decimal separator with many fractional digits."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "PT0.123456789S")
        # Microsecond precision, so last 3 digits should be rounded
        assert result.microsecond == 123457

    def test_exact_microsecond_at_boundary(self):
        """Fractional seconds that result in exact microsecond boundary."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "PT1.5S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 0, 0, 1, 500000)

    def test_february_non_leap_to_leap_year(self):
        """Adding years from non-leap to leap year February."""
        # 2025 is not leap, 2024 is leap
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 2, 28), "P1Y")
        # 2025-02-28 + 1Y = 2026-02-28 (2026 is not leap)
        assert result == datetime(2026, 2, 28)

    def test_exactly_hundred_years(self):
        """Adding exactly 100 years."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2000, 3, 15), "P100Y")
        assert result == datetime(2100, 3, 15)

    def test_exactly_thousand_months(self):
        """Adding exactly 1000 months."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2000, 1, 1), "P1000M")
        # 1000 months = 83 years 4 months
        # 2000-01-01 + 1000M = 2083-05-01
        assert result == datetime(2083, 5, 1)

    def test_string_with_all_valid_digit_formats(self):
        """Duration string with various valid digit formats."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15), "P001Y002M003D")
        assert result == datetime(2026, 3, 18)

    def test_zero_duration_all_zeros(self):
        """Duration with all zero components."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 12, 30, 45), "P0Y0M0DT0H0M0S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 12, 30, 45)

    def test_leap_year_february_plus_one_month(self):
        """Feb 28 non-leap + 1 year (to leap), then + 1 day."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 2, 28), "P1Y1D")
        # 2025-02-28 + 1Y = 2026-02-28
        # 2026-02-28 + 1D = 2026-03-01
        assert result == datetime(2026, 3, 1)

    def test_add_duration_preserves_microseconds_when_not_adding_time(self):
        """Microseconds are preserved when only adding date components."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 12, 30, 45, 123456), "P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 11, 12, 30, 45, 123456)

    def test_fractional_weeks_with_comma(self):
        """Fractional weeks using comma separator."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1,5W")
        # 1.5W = 10.5 days
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 20, 12, 0, 0)

    def test_negative_with_fractional_component(self):
        """Negative duration with fractional component."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 12), "-P0.5D")
        # -0.5D = -12H
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 0, 0)
